system.topology: Two MX-106 actuators on a common shaft through a 55:24 external spur gear; 14.8 V nominal bench supply.

conventions.energy_positive_direction: Unknown; no energy-flow integration is claimed.
conventions.reference_frame: Common hip-roll shaft; actuator-local voltage registers.
conventions.sampling_time_basis: Raw log timestamps are present. Sample-count threshold excursions are recorded; no continuous duration is asserted.

test_conditions.load_profile: 11.7275 N m gravity load, source run group B-A; 2.18 rad/s target, direction +1 in run configuration.
test_conditions.motion_profile: Downhill/overhauling-load attempt marked by the source as regenerative overvoltage; operating quadrant remains unknown because signed electrical current/power is absent.
test_conditions.cooling_boundary: Ambient/cooling not fully specified for these transient runs.
notes: The supply was source-only and unable to sink regenerated current.

evidence.method: Source paper and its run ledger identify three downhill regenerative overvoltage attempts and the 16.0 V limit.
Author run ledger; raw run IDs and invalidation reasons.
800-row raw actuator voltage log. Independent maximum-value/count scan reproduced 24.1 V and 58 samples above 16.0 V for drive 1; 23.8 V and 58 for drive 2.

claim_ceiling: Source-log audit confirms actuator-reported voltage exceeded the prespecified 16.0 V limit in three downhill attempts on a source-only bench supply. It does not quantify bus current, regenerative energy, energy accepted by storage, net efficiency, or an independent calibrated bus voltage.
